title: Haze mostly lifted, Sarawak's Samalaju only area with unhealthy air reading - The Edge Malaysia
text:
Haze mostly lifted, Sarawak's Samalaju only area with unhealthy air reading Tuesday 27 Oct 2026 BURSA SGX Home 
 Make The Edge Malaysia your preferred source on Google KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 27): Samalaju in Sarawak recorded an air pollutant index (API) reading in the unhealthy range at 110, while 46 areas nationwide recorded moderate readings as of 4pm on Tuesday.
 According to the Department of Environment’s Malaysian Air Pollutant Index Management System (APIMS) portal, Bintulu recorded the highest API reading in the moderate category at 91, followed by Batu Muda in Kuala Lumpur, and Batu Pahat and Kluang in Johor, each with a reading of 88.
 The monitoring station at the Serian district police headquarters in Sarawak recorded a reading of 80, followed by Samarahan and Kuching (76 each), and Keningau in Sabah (75).
 Twenty-one areas recorded API readings in the good range, with Banting in Selangor and Indera Mahkota in Kuantan, Pahang, each recording a reading of 50, followed by Kimanis in Sabah (49).
 API readings of zero to 50 are categorised as good, 51 to 100 as moderate, 101 to 200 as unhealthy, 201 to 300 as very unhealthy, while readings above 300 are categorised as hazardous.
